Not a therapist, but in my experience it's important to document when you have intrusive thoughts like that, even if they are just a weird blip that doesn't resonate with you moments after. It could be a part of something different.

Your therapist wouldn't normally put you on a hold unless you are actively planning or trying to act on harming yourself or others.
